items.title: Inventory legacy Koala dev-memory entries and define supersession mapping
items.context: Scan project/global dev-memory for Koala/.koala/koala-* terms. Preserve old entries as historical evidence, but define a machine-readable supersession mapping to Proofbound/Lattice terminology.
items.userSees: dev_memory_search/list output identifies legacy Koala memory ids and shows which current Proofbound/Lattice memory supersedes them.

happy.desc: Inventory finds global dev-memory entries containing Koala/.koala/koala-* and maps each to current Proofbound/Lattice terminology without editing old rows.

edge.desc: Legacy entries without a matching superseding entry remain readable and are marked legacy-readable rather than silently hidden.

adversarial.desc: A cleanup attempt must not rewrite or delete historical evidenceRefs from old dev-memory rows.

verificationEvidence.note: Inventory found legacy Koala ids a6832a1, f4fe749, c948c85, 2de5d6b, and 7bc20e5 and mapped them to current Proofbound/Lattice superseding entries 34e97f9, 99aa6c7, ee3aef3, 148297b, and 7ffe281.
Smoke check legacy entry remains readable and visibly annotated as superseded / legacy-readable.
Commit adds only new project dev-memory rows plus source/docs/smoke changes; legacy global rows are not rewritten or deleted.

items.title: Implement dev-memory supersession priority for preflight/search/list consumers
items.context: Entries tagged supersedes-<id> or referencing dev-memory:<id> should cause the superseding entry to rank ahead of legacy entries; legacy entries should remain readable but show superseded metadata so hosts do not treat old Koala terms as active guidance.
items.userSees: dev_memory_preflight/search/list shows current Proofbound/Lattice superseding guidance before legacy Koala entries and annotates superseded ids.

happy.desc: Entries with tags like supersedes-<id> or evidenceRefs like dev-memory:<id> rank ahead of superseded entries in search/preflight.

edge.desc: List output remains newest-first while still annotating superseded legacy entries when a superseding entry exists.

adversarial.desc: A legacy Koala entry must not be presented as active guidance when a current Proofbound/Lattice superseding entry is present.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke proves tags supersedes-<id> and evidenceRefs dev-memory:<id> compute a projection and rank current entries before superseded legacy entries in search and preflight.
List remains newest-first for project entries while annotating each superseding status and preserving readable entry formatting.
Search output shows current Proofbound/Lattice superseding entries before their legacy Koala counterparts and marks old entries superseded / legacy-readable.

items.title: Capture current Proofbound/Lattice superseding memories for legacy Koala lessons
items.context: Add project/global memory entries that map legacy Koala reviewer/delivery/CLI lessons to current Proofbound/Lattice naming. Do not mutate old evidence refs.
items.userSees: Project dev-memory contains current Proofbound/Lattice superseding lessons for old Koala reviewer, delivery, CLI, and preflight lessons.

happy.desc: New superseding memories exist for legacy Koala reviewer/delivery/CLI/preflight lessons and cite the superseded dev-memory ids.

edge.desc: Superseding memories preserve legacy evidenceRefs by reference instead of duplicating or rewriting old historical entries.

adversarial.desc: New memories must say Proofbound/Lattice and not introduce fresh active Koala guidance.

items.title: Add smoke coverage for superseded dev-memory ordering and legacy terminology mapping
items.context: A test should prove superseding entries rank before superseded legacy entries and that legacy Koala memories remain readable but are marked as superseded.
items.userSees: Running dev-memory supersession smoke prints that superseded legacy Koala entries remain readable while current Proofbound/Lattice entries are preferred.

happy.desc: Smoke proves superseding entries rank before superseded legacy entries and visible output includes superseded metadata.

edge.desc: Smoke proves legacy Koala entries remain readable as legacy-readable/superseded rather than disappearing.

adversarial.desc: Smoke proves dev-memory entries remain gateEvidence=false and authority=non_authoritative after supersession projection.
